==Biography==
Emil "'''Larssen'''" Larsson has been gaming since his youth, when he played Call of Duty and Pokémon.

'''2019''' 

In late 2018, he took the decision to finish school rather than compete in the [[LEC/2019 Season/Spring Season|LEC 2019 Spring Season]]<ref>[http://www.twitlonger.com/show/n_1sqnsci Larssen's TwitLonger] ''twitlonger.com''</ref> despite Rogue offering him the starting spot from the Beginning.<ref> [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NmG7b-cVjrw&t=2063s Thorin's Reflections with Larssen] </ref> After finishing School in early 2019, Larssen then joined the LEC Main Squad for Rogue, together with [[Inspired]], [[Woolite]], [[Vander]] and [[Profit]], who would later in the season and for the Play-offs be replaced by [[Finn]]. They finished 6th in the Regular Season, beating out [[Origen]] for the last Play-offs spot and tying them in a 7-11 score. During the Play-offs, Rogue finished 4th overall, winning in Round 1 against [[Splyce]] by beating them 3-0, and in the second Round losing to [[FC Schalke 04 Esports]] 3-1.
The match against Schalke also brought on a very famous meme for Larssen, the so-called Larssen Corki Package<ref> [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MyefJa7EBdM Jankos Reacts to Larssen Corki Package] </ref>.

'''2020 '''

In 2020, Larssen remained on the team, together with [[Inspired]] , [[Finn]] and [[Vander]]. Only [[Woolite]] was replaced by [[Hans Sama]]. 

The [[LEC/2020 Season/Spring Season|LEC 2020 Spring Season]] saw Rogue finish the Regular Season with an even score of 9-9, despite going on a four games losing streak as soon as the format switched to Online; they finished the last offline Week with a 2-0. Their slow, methodical gameplay had earned Rogue a reputation of being a boring team, and despite that, they beat out [[Misfits Gaming]] heading into Play-Offs, with a 3-1 score. In the next round, they lost to [[Origen]] with, once again, a 3-1.

== Trivia ==
* Favorite football team is Manchester United.
* Favorite meal is tacos.
* Is a big fan of Madison Beer <ref>[[https://x.com/Larssen00/status/1569412147712507908?s=20 Larssen's Tweet]] </ref>.
* Used to look up to [[Perkz]] as a player.
* Is the younger brother of [[Lannister]].
* Is from Välingetorp in Sweden and grew up on a farm <ref>[[https://www.tiktok.com/@lec/video/7200413447983598854?lang=de-DE LEC Tiktok]] </ref>.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on July 3, 2023.
** The 11th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], [[Odoamne]], and [[Upset]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* 2x EU 2nd All Pro Team (Summer 2020, Spring 2021)
* 2x EU 3rd All Pro Team (Spring 2022, Winter 2023)
